mainEntity.name: Do you clean treatment rooms?

mainEntity.name: What products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our standard line is Armstrong's ProSeries Green, which is third-party certified to UL Environment (ECOLOGO) standards and fragrance-free — which matters for patients with allergies or sensitivities. mainEntity.name: Can you clean while the clinic is open?

mainEntity.name: How often should our office be cleaned?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on how many people use the space and how it is used. Busy offices are usually cleaned every weeknight; smaller or quieter offices a few evenings a week or weekly. We recommend a frequency at the walkthrough and put it in writing, and it can be changed later through your account executive.

mainEntity.name: Do you clean after hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Office cleaning is normally done in the evening or overnight after staff leave, or at weekends, so nobody has to work around the crew.

mainEntity.name: Will the same cleaners come every time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A dedicated team is assigned to your property so the people cleaning it know the building, its access arrangements and your preferences.

mainEntity.name: Are your cleaners screened and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cleaning staff undergo background screening, and the business is bonded and covered by liability insurance and WSIB Ontario.

mainEntity.name: How is the price worked out?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a free on-site walkthrough. The size and layout of the space, how often it is cleaned, the type of facility, floor types and any periodic work, the hours the work must happen in and building access all change the price, so we look before we quote.

mainEntity.name: What cleaning products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use Armstrong Manufacturing's ProSeries Green line, which is third-party certified to UL Environment (ECOLOGO) standards, fragrance-free and free of VOCs.

mainEntity.name: Which areas do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Toronto (including North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, East York and York), Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Pickering, Ajax and Oshawa.
